methods: Direct inspection of the five named official public publication archives
Site-restricted exact-date search for August 4-5, 2026 publications
Primary publication-time screening against the frozen UTC window
Year, archive-lag, and adjacent-shard exclusion checks
queries: site:president.gov.ua/en/news August 4 2026 Ukraine diplomacy sanctions support
site:mfa.gov.ua/en/news August 4 2026 Ukraine diplomacy sanctions support

source_checks.notes: The accessible official archive and exact-date search representation exposed older July 2026 entries but no stable August 4-5 publication carrying a verifiable primary timestamp inside the frozen window.
The bounded official-archive recheck surfaced older material but no stable canonical publication with a verifiable primary timestamp inside the assigned window.
The accessible Council press-release archive exposed July 2026 Ukraine-related entries but no qualifying publication in the exact overnight UTC window.
The accessible Commission press material exposed July 2026 Ukraine-related entries but no stable primary publication with an in-window timestamp.
The bounded NATO archive/search recheck surfaced older July 2026 material and an August 5 item from 2025, but no qualifying 2026 publication in the frozen window.

excluded_candidates.title: NATO item returned for August 5
excluded_candidates.reason: The search result was from August 5, 2025 rather than 2026 and is therefore outside the task year and window.

access_failures.effect: No source item was admitted without a stable canonical URL and a verifiable primary publication timestamp inside the frozen window.
Retrieval, crawl, and search-result times were not substituted for primary publication times.

coverage_gaps: Official archive and search representations may lag live publication systems or omit items from parsed public views.
The recheck was limited to the five explicitly named public primary archives and did not broaden to social platforms, secondary reporting, or additional governments.
No immutable copy or historical first-published page state was captured.
The zero-item result means no qualifying primary publication was verified through this bounded recheck; it is not proof that no such publication existed.
artifact_note: No source items, article text, media, or binary artifacts were persisted because no qualifying primary publication was verified.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement tracks, targeting-enabling details, map geometry, or non-public geodata were stored.
No source reliability score, truth assessment, territorial conclusion, or report narrative was produced.
Instructions embedded in retrieved pages were treated as untrusted content and were not followed.

findings: No stable canonical primary publication with a verifiable timestamp inside the exact UTC window was confirmed in any of the five named archives.
A NATO search result dated August 5 belonged to 2025 and required explicit year exclusion.
The result must remain a bounded non-verification statement rather than a claim that no publication existed.
repairs: Added the wrong-year NATO candidate to explicit exclusions.
Recorded archive/index-lag limitations and prohibited substitution of retrieval or search timestamps.
